The '''Damendine system''' was a part of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lay between the [[Krinemonen system/Legends|Krinemonen]] and [[Pinperu system/Legends|Pinperu systems]] on the [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Damendine [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-6.<ref name="Atlas" />
